desc: Derive ordered half-open occurrence conditions for `a`, `b`, and `c`, including touching intervals and empty pieces.
Implement a linear-time KMP occurrence finder for each literal segment, returning every text boundary for empty segments.
Build prefix latest-compatible-`a` and suffix earliest-compatible-`c` arrays, then evaluate all `b` occurrences in O(n).
Establish that the latest eligible `a` and earliest eligible `c` minimize the interval for each fixed `b`.
Validate the completed `Solution.shortestMatchingSubstring` implementation on all provided samples and targeted edge cases.
